Estimated items:
- Cappuccino or latte in a mug, about 150 ml with milk: ~70 kcal, 4 g protein, 6 g carbs, 3 g fat.
- Banana, medium: ~105 kcal, 1.3 g protein, 27 g carbs, 0.4 g fat.
- Cornflakes, about 30 g: ~113 kcal, 2 g protein, 25 g carbs, 0.2 g fat.
- Milk in the bottle, about 200 ml whole: ~130 kcal, 6.5 g protein, 9.5 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Two sugar sticks at 4 g each: ~32 kcal, 8 g carbs.

Served total: about 450 kcal.

Leftover is unknown since the photo shows the meal before eating. I assumed a small amount is left, such as part of the banana peel (not edible, so not counted) or a little milk. I set leftover at about 20 kcal, so the person eats about 430 kcal.

Eaten macros are close to the served totals, minus the small leftover:
- Protein: 4 + 1.3 + 2 + 6.5 = 13.8 g, so about 13 g after leftovers.
- Carbs: 6 + 27 + 25 + 9.5 + 8 = 75.5 g, so about 73 g after leftovers.
- Fat: 3 + 0.4 + 0.2 + 7 = 10.6 g, so about 10 g after leftovers.
